messages.author: 55cb20da3fe82e18
messages.subject: Update in shiny 0.30 breaks 10_download example (?)
parts:
I recently update to shiny 0.30 (so could be missing some dependency, but the update didn't complain). The 10_download example (http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#downloads) now spits the following when you click on the Download Data button:

Listening on port 8100
Error in function (value)  : 
  invalid replacement for field ‘.label’, should be from class “character” or a subclass (was class “NULL”)

The same function works fine in shiny 0.21 (where it was originally fixed to take files in the content function)

I'm probably doing something wrong but can others confirm if they are seeing the same or different behavior?

Thanks

-Haider

messages.subject: Re: Update in shiny 0.30 breaks 10_download example (?)
parts:
Yes, sorry, this is broken in Shiny 0.3.0. It's fixed on GitHub, which you can install with:

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("shiny", "rstudio")
